title: Gift a Membership
name: Gift a Membership

body.html:
Student ($35)

Designed for students enrolled in accredited academic or arts institutions, our Student Membership provides access to Open Studios, discounted film processing, and all the benefits of our Individual tier at a student-friendly rate. See all benefits here.

Educator ($35)

For individuals employed by an accredited academic or arts institution—enjoy all of the same benefits as our Individual tier at a discounted rate. See all benefits here.

Individual ($75)

Join a growing community of artists and creatives. With Individual Membership, enjoy a wide range of benefits, including discounts on workshops, access to exclusive member events & open calls, and much more. See all benefits here.

Dual Membership ($100)

Save on membership by signing up with a friend! Our Dual Membership unlocks access to the same benefits as our Individual tier, but for two. See all benefits here.

Professional ($350)  

Take your support to the next level with Professional Membership. Receive premium perks, including 20% off workshops, a complimentary tintype session, and more. See all benefits here.

Pro Studio ($550)  

Pro Studio membership offers exclusive discounts on renting our northlight Highlight Studio—ideal for commercial and studio photographers. See all benefits here.

Patron ($1000)  

Patron members receive invitations to Penumbra Advisory and Executive Board events and private programs with artists and curators, along with all of the benefits included in our Professional and Pro Studio tiers. See all benefits here.
